reviewed_by: Claude review of the frozen Core Kali build helper bundling
reason: Packaging-only change. sandbox.py copies public_ip_update.py and terminal_entrypoint.sh (added in a27a8f5) into the Kali image build context via Path(__file__).with_name(), but scripts/build_nebula_core.py never bundled them, so a PyInstaller Core raised FileNotFoundError before docker build and could never prepare the workstation image. The build script now bundles both, package_audit.REQUIRED_MEMBERS requires every Kali build helper (egress_helper.py was also unaudited), and a new test fails when any file read beside its module is not bundled and audited. Selected: the new bundling test, the artifact member audit tests (their required-member list changed) and the build script import check.
exclusions: No runtime source, UI, native or browser changes, so frontend, native and Playwright layers are empty. The rest of test_packaging.py is not selected because it does not exercise the changed lists; test_nebula3_runtime_has_no_conditional_import_fallbacks already fails on main (chat.py) independently of this change.
